# function: apigateway_gateway_response

Builds the ARN for `apigateway` `GatewayResponse`:

```
arn:${Partition}:apigateway:${Region}::/restapis/${RestApiId}/gatewayresponses/${ResponseType}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:apigateway:ap-northeast-1::/restapis/rest-api-id/gatewayresponses/response-type
output "apigateway_gateway_response" {
  value = provider::arn::apigateway_gateway_response("rest-api-id", "response-type")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
apigateway_gateway_response(rest_api_id string, response_type string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `rest_api_id` (String) Value for `${RestApiId}` in the ARN template.
1. `response_type` (String) Value for `${ResponseType}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
